title: The Singing Grass
rumor: The Singing Grass. There is a broad stretch of prairie where the wind produces a strange, beautiful music. Thalenweald tradition holds that the songs preserve the memories of the land, and that those who listen carefully can hear the voices of its former inhabitants. One traveler claims to have learned the location of a buried treasure from the melody.
first_lead: Thalenweald travelers can identify the valley by a distinctive ring of low red hills.
